title: Episode 4
logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

blocks.camera:

Start: (00:36.00) | End: (00:38.90)

"Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:38.90) | End: (00:41.50)

blocks.camera:

Medium close-up of Juliana.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Soft, Bitter):

blocks.camera:

"I know they have made you stand alone."

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (V.O.):

blocks.camera:

"Then... let us proceed."

"You need not say anything you do not mean."

Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.

"You have my protection."

"You have my respect."

Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.

blocks.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave):

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Furious, Shouting):
blocks.text:

blocks.camera:
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (01:59.00)
Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

blocks.text:

"For a penniless nobody!"

blocks.camera:
Start: (01:59.00) | End: (02:02.80)

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):

"I would rather choose my own life..."
